description: This header file defines utilities, macros, classes, and functions for integrating UCC (Unified Collective Communications) with PyTorch's distributed package, including error handling, logging, and communication management.

classes.name: ProcessGroupUCCLogger
classes.description: Logger class for UCC process group, managing log prefixes and communication tracing.

classes.name: torch_ucc_oob_coll_info_t
classes.description: Structure holding out-of-band collective info, including store, communication ID, rank, size, and message buffer.

classes.name: CommBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for UCC communication, providing progress and request management.

classes.name: CommUCC
classes.description: Implementation of CommBase for UCC, managing UCC library and context handles.

methods.name: ProcessGroupUCCLogger
methods.description: Constructor for logger, initializes log prefix and phase.

methods.name: getLogPrefix
methods.description: Returns the log prefix string for a given phase.

methods.name: setPhase
methods.description: Sets the current phase of the logger.

methods.name: flushComms
methods.description: Flushes communication logs for a given rank and world size.

methods.name: progress
methods.description: Virtual method to progress communication, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: free_request
methods.description: Virtual method to free a UCC collective request.

methods.name: CommUCC
methods.description: Constructor for UCC communication class, initializes with out-of-band info and logger.

methods.name: oob_allgather_test
methods.description: Tests the status of an out-of-band allgather request.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string view.

methods.name: tolower
methods.description: Converts a string view to lowercase.

methods.name: parse_list
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list string into a vector of lowercase trimmed strings.
